Answer: C
Reason: The ultrasound images demonstrate a multicystic lesion in the fetal right lower lung zone (adjacent to the heart/diaphragm interface) with color Doppler confirming a systemic arterial supply, characteristic of a hybrid CPAM/sequestration; this location corresponds to the lower lobe, and unlike large upper/middle lobe masses, it typically does not cause significant mediastinal shift or diaphragmatic inversion.
